definitions.ttft: HTTP request start to first nonempty content, reasoning, or tool-call delta; role-only chunks excluded
definitions.e2e: HTTP request start to stream completion
definitions.tpot: (E2E - TTFT)/(server completion_tokens - 1); absent if usage missing or completion_tokens <= 1
definitions.percentiles: linear interpolation across successful requests; missing samples excluded and n reported
definitions.streaming: A streamed chunk can contain multiple tokens, especially with speculative decoding; TPOT is request-average, not per-token ITL
